## Summary by CodeRabbit

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

Added AST and semantic project indexing with prioritized, token-bounded context assembly. Integrated both services into the enhanced agent. Updated architecture documentation, workspace guidance, hooks, MCP configuration, tests, and automation rules.

### Changes

**Context Indexing and Agent Workflow**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**IndexerService storage and indexing** <br> `package.json`, `services/IndexerService.js`, `tests/IndexerService.test.js`, `Docs/architecture/ADR-003-context-indexing.md`|Added Tree-sitter parsing, transformer embeddings, LanceDB storage, file watching, symbol search, embedding search, project indexing, and mocked tests.|
|**Prioritized context assembly** <br> `services/ContextAssembler.js`, `tests/ContextAssembler.test.js`, `.agents/INDEXING.md`|Added explicit-file, plan-file, symbol, semantic, token-budget, deduplication, and README fallback handling.|
|**Enhanced agent integration** <br> `lib/agent-enhanced.js`, `lib/agent.js`|The enhanced agent initializes indexing, assembles context during chat and project analysis, and passes assembled context to the base agent.|
|**Architecture and release documentation** <br> `AGENTS.md`, `BRAIN.md`, `README.md`, `Docs/architecture/*`|Updated versions, test totals, module maps, architecture diagrams, execution flows, client diagrams, and context-indexing documentation.|
|**Workspace guidance and automation** <br> `.agents/*`|Added prompt hooks, MCP servers, workflow instructions, indexing guidance, synchronization rules, and expanded automation documentation.|

**Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes

### Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant LorapokEnhancedAgent
  participant ContextAssembler
  participant IndexerService
  participant LanceDB
  User->>LorapokEnhancedAgent: submit prompt
  LorapokEnhancedAgent->>ContextAssembler: assemble prompt context
  ContextAssembler->>IndexerService: search symbols and embeddings
  IndexerService->>LanceDB: query indexed records
  LanceDB-->>IndexerService: return matches
  IndexerService-->>ContextAssembler: return ranked matches
  ContextAssembler-->>LorapokEnhancedAgent: return assembledContext
  LorapokEnhancedAgent-->>User: return model response
```

- [Maijied/Lorapok_AI_Agent#14](https://github.com/Maijied/Lorapok_AI_Agent/pull/14): Shares architecture documentation and `lib/agent.js` updates. This PR extends that layering with context assembly and indexing.
